notes.title: Major bug fixes update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We noticed you had serious problems when a puzzle is solved and you cannot click again in anything. We solved this issue in addition with other minor bugs that were reported in the "discussion" section of the game. We also corrected currently saved games that faced this issue, so if you experienced this error, you can load the slot and everything should load correctly, letting you to click to all puzzles and  sections of the game.

We encourage you to discuss the bugs in the discussion section in order to fast check them. Thank you for everything and sorry for the late update date.

See you!!

notes.title: Clue / Hint major update
notes.content:
[h1]Release update:[/h1]

[olist]
[*] Solved minor bugs including the painting puzzle bug
[*] Added clue/hint in the game
[/olist]
We are aware that some of the puzzles are not very clear, so we listened to you and decided to add a clue / hint behavior on our game. We are very sorry if some puzzles have been a major problem to you.

[b]Thanks for the comprehension!![/b]
